reviewMethod: Read all 50 compiled entries, all 277 stored occurrences and full-case actor/source records; retested ordinary scene, Zen bend, title/catalogue/substring contamination, exact utterer prose, and the mandatory karma brief controls including reader-visible evidence and the 255/257 scope.

rows.priorFinding: REVISE — The repaired ordinary scene for 焚香 is materially better, but the evidence paragraph still relies on reusable or anonymous prose (‘The selected clauses name the act, its ceremonial setting, and the recipient rather than treating incense as an empty symbol’). It does not name the stored actor and work for each important inference, distinguish narrated/title/questioner frames, or report a concrete falsification boundary, so it still fails PROSE_HYGIENE questions 3, 8, 9, and 10.
rows.finding: Dongming Huiqian is made to name every act, setting, and recipient. The entry does not distinguish documentary ceremony wording from a master’s utterance or map beneficiary claims to exact quotes.
